description: Tengyue Xie publishes a Python calibration and response-policy pipeline for the China–Europe Railway Express. The July 2026 ZIP includes 2018–2025 alert episodes, derived daily series, coverage masks, statistical calibration and a replay of the September 2025 Poland–Belarus closure. Code is MIT and data are CC BY 4.0, freely downloadable with a specified Python environment. The raw GDELT extract is omitted, with rebuild instructions and checksums supplied instead. These resources can test how uncertain geopolitical alerts affect rail-freight decisions in disruption simulations. Related catalogue record data-china-europe-railway-express-disruptions covers the separate ground-truth database, not this decision pipeline. News-reporting coverage and assumed response costs limit transferability; operational effectiveness remains untested. The associated manuscript is under review. Scripts and alert files were not downloaded or run.
